intent.outcome: mp config set writes to the plan-local config by default inside a project, never writes outside the plan dir as a side effect, and relocating the plan dir is a single atomic command.

problem.description: Field testing (lazybrew adoption, I-01/I-02/I-08/I-11) found: (1) `mp config set` without --plan-dir writes to an unresolvable/global scope instead of the plan-local config, so changes silently do not apply; (2) `mp config set --plan-dir .mp ...` created a side-effect master-plan/config.toml redirect outside the plan dir; (3) after renaming .mp/->master-plan/, mp doctor failed because config still recorded location='.mp', with no command to relocate; (4) there is no documented cutover/rename recipe, so the agent invented mv + config set and still hit dangling doc references.

in_scope: `mp config set` defaults to the plan-local config when run inside a project with a plan dir (--plan-dir still overrides)
config set never creates files outside the plan directory
New `mp plan relocate <old> <new>`: renames the dir and updates workflow.plan.location atomically
docs/CUTOVER.md recipe: parallel-bootstrap cutover + rename + post-cutover link-lint guidance
Integration tests: config set plan-local default; no out-of-plan writes; relocate keeps doctor green
out_of_scope: Automatic repo-wide link linting for arbitrary markdown refs (document the manual check instead)

acceptance_criteria.description: `mp config set --plan-dir X ...` writes only inside X; no master-plan/config.toml side effect
acceptance_criteria.evidence: config_scope_no_sideeffect tests pass; --plan-dir writes only inside plan dir

acceptance_criteria.evidence: plan_relocate tests pass; mp plan relocate renames dir and updates location

acceptance_criteria.evidence: docs/CUTOVER.md written with rename + location update + post-cutover check
